message.content:
The Moon page gives the minimum perigee as 356400 km. I’m fetching Kipchoge’s Wikipedia record time to complete the calculation using the same source-based method.
```python
kipchoge_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge", max_chars=12000)
print(kipchoge_page)
```
I’m extracting the marathon record time from the retrieved page and calculating the travel time in hours, rounded to the nearest 1000.
```python
import re

record_match = re.search(r'2:01:09', kipchoge_page)
record_seconds = 2 * 3600 + 1 * 60 + 9
marathon_km = 42.195
perigee_km = 356400
pace_km_per_hour = marathon_km / (record_seconds / 3600)
hours = perigee_km / pace_km_per_hour
rounded_hours = round(hours / 1000) * 1000
calculation = f"record_found={bool(record_match)} pace_km_per_hour={pace_km_per_hour:.6f} hours={hours:.2f} rounded={rounded_hours}"
print(calculation)
```
17000 hours
